I will also exterminate thee, That there may be no inhabitant:<div eID="gen91239" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91240" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>And the coast of the sea shall be a habitation For sheepcots of shepherds and folds for sheep; (<hi type="bold">242</hi>)<div eID="gen91240" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91241" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">7 </hi>And that coast shall be For the residence of the house of Judah; Among them shall they feed; In the houses of Ashkelon Shall they in the evening lie down; For visit them shall Jehovah their God, and he will restore their captivity.<div eID="gen91241" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91242" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">8 </hi>Heard have I the reproach of Moab, And the revilings of the children of Ammon; By which they have upbraided my people; And they have extended themselves over their border: (<hi type="bold">247</hi>)<div eID="gen91242" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91243" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">9 </hi>Therefore <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, Saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, — Surely Moab like Sodom shall be, And the children of Ammon like Gomorrah, A soil for the nettle and a mine for salt, And a waste for ever; The residue of my people shall plunder them, And the remnant of my nation shall possess them.<div eID="gen91243" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91244" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">10 </hi>This shall be to them for their pride; Because they have reproached, And exulted over the people of Jehovah of hosts.<div eID="gen91244" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91245" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">11 </hi>Terrible will Jehovah be to them; For he will consume all the gods of the earth, And worship him shall each from his place, All the islands of the nations. —<div eID="gen91245" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91246" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">12 </hi>Ye also Ethiopians! — Slain by my sword shall they be.<div eID="gen91246" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91247" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">13 </hi>And extend will he his hand to the north, And he will destroy Assyria, And set Nineveh a waste, A desolation like the desert:<div eID="gen91247" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91248" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">14 </hi>And lie down within it shall flocks, All the beasts of the nations; Even the bittern and the owl Shall on its pillars pass the night; A voice shall sing in the window, In the door-way there shall be desolation, For he will make bare the cedar.<div eID="gen91248" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91249" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">15 </hi>This is the exulting city! Which sat in confidence, Which said in her heart, — “I am, and there is besides me no other.” How is she become a waste, A resting-place for beasts! Every one who shall pass by Will hiss at her, he will shake his hand.<div eID="gen91249" type="x-p"/><div eID="gen91233"/> <div sID="gen91250"/> <div sID="gen91251" type="x-p"/>CHAPTER 3<div eID="gen91251" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91252" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">1 </hi>Wo to the polluted and the filthy — The city which is an oppressor! (<hi type="bold">261</hi>)<div eID="gen91252" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91253" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">2 </hi>She has not attended to the voice, She has not received correction, In Jehovah has she not trusted, To her God she has not drawn nigh!<div eID="gen91253" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91254" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">3 </hi>Her princes within her are roaring lions, Her judges, the wolves of the evening; They break not the bones in the morning!<div eID="gen91254" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91255" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">4 </hi>Her Prophets are vain, men of deceits; (268) Her Priests have polluted what is holy, They have subverted the law. (<hi type="bold">269</hi>)<div eID="gen91255" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91256" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">5 </hi>Jehovah is just in the midst of her, He will not do iniquity; Every morning his judgment He brings to light, — he fails not: Yet the unjust knoweth no shame.<div eID="gen91256" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91257" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>I have cut off nations, Waste have become their citadels, I have destroyed their streets, So that no one passes through; Wasted have become their cities, That there is not a man, not an inhabitant: (<hi type="bold">275</hi>)<div eID="gen91257" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91258" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">7 </hi>I said, “surely, thou wilt fear me, Thou wilt receive instruction;” Then cut off should not be her habitation, However I might have visited her: — (<hi type="bold">279</hi>) Truly! they have hastened, They have corrupted all their doings!<div eID="gen91258" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91259" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">8 </hi>Therefore look for me, saith Jehovah, Till the day when I shall rise up for the prey; For my purpose is, To gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, That I may pour upon them my wrath, The whole fury of mine anger; For with the fire of my indignation Shall be devoured the whole earth. (<hi type="bold">281</hi>)<div eID="gen91259" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91260" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">9 </hi>But I will then turn to the people a pure lip, That they may all call on the name of Jehovah, That they may serve him with one consent. (<hi type="bold">283</hi>)<div eID="gen91260" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91261" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">10 </hi>Beyond the rivers of Ethiopia shall be my suppliants; The daughter of my dispersed shall bring mine offering.<div eID="gen91261" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91262" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">11 </hi>In that day thou shalt not be ashamed On account of all thy doings, By which thou hast transgressed against me; For then will I remove from the midst of thee Those who rejoice in thy pride, And thou shalt not take pride any more In my holy mountain. (<hi type="bold">292</hi>)<div eID="gen91262" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91263" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">12 </hi>And I will cause to remain in the midst of thee, A people afflicted and poor; And they shall trust in the name of Jehovah.<div eID="gen91263" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91264" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">13 </hi>The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, And they shall not speak falsehood, And not found in their mouth Shall be a deceitful tongue; And they shall feed and lie down, And there shall be none to terrify <hi type="italic">them</hi><div eID="gen91264" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91265" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">14 </hi>Exult thou daughter of Sion, Exult thou Israel; Rejoice, exult with thy whole heart, Thou daughter of je: (<hi type="bold">299</hi>)<div eID="gen91265" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91266" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">15 </hi>Removed has Jehovah thy judgments, He has turned aside thine enemies; The King of Israel, Jehovah, is in the midst of thee, Thou shalt see evil no more.<div eID="gen91266" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91267" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">16 </hi>In that day it shall be said to je, Fear not; Sion! relaxed let not thine hands be.<div eID="gen91267" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91268" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">17 </hi>Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, He is strong, he will save; He will exult over thee with joy, He will rest in his love, (<hi type="bold">304</hi>) He will exult over thee with triumph.<div eID="gen91268" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91269" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">18 </hi>The afflicted, at the appointed time, Will I gather, — who shall be of thee; Who sustained for her reproach. (<hi type="bold">308</hi>)<div eID="gen91269" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91270" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">19 </hi>Behold, I will destroy all thine oppressors at that time, And I will save the halting, And restore the driven away, To make them a praise and a name In the land of their reproach.<div eID="gen91270" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91271" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">20 </hi>At that time will I restore you, At that time will I gather you; For I will make you a name and a praise Among all the nations of the earth; When I shall restore your captivities, Before your eyes saith Jehovah.<div eID="gen91271" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91272" type="x-p"/>end of new translation of zephaniah.<div eID="gen91272" type="x-p"/><div eID="gen91250"/><div eID="gen91209"/> <div sID="gen91273"/> <div sID="gen91274" type="x-p"/>A TRANSLATION of<div eID="gen91274" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91275" type="x-p"/>CALVIN’S VERSION of<div eID="gen91275" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91276" type="x-p"/>THE BOOK OF HAGGAI<div eID="gen91276" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91277"/> <div sID="gen91278" type="x-p"/>CHAPTER 1<div eID="gen91278" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91279" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">1 </hi>In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the Prophet, to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying —<div eID="gen91279" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91280" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">2 </hi>Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, saying — This people say, “The time is not come To build the house of Jehovah.”<div eID="gen91280" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91281" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">3 </hi>Then came the word of Jehovah, By Haggai, the Prophet, saying —<div eID="gen91281" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91282" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">4 </hi>“Is it time for you To dwell yourselves in your boarded houses, And this house a waste!”<div eID="gen91282" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91283" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">5 </hi>And now thus saith Jehovah of hosts, — Apply your heart to your ways:<div eID="gen91283" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91284" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>Ye have sown much, and brought in little; Ye have eaten, and were not satisfied; Ye have drank, and were not replenished; Ye have clothed yourselves, and were not warmed; And he who gains wages, Gains wages for a perforated bag. (<hi type="bold">330</hi>)<div eID="gen91284" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91285" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">7 </hi>Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, — Apply your heart to your ways;<div eID="gen91285" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91286" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">8 </hi>Ascend unto the mountain and bring wood, And build the house; And I will be <hi type="italic">to you</hi> propitious in it, And glorified shall I be, saith Jehovah. (<hi type="bold">333</hi>)<div eID="gen91286" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91287" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">9 </hi>Ye have looked for much, but behold little! And ye brought it home, and I blew on it: Why is this? saith Jehovah; On account of my house, because it is waste, And ye run, each of you to his own house.<div eID="gen91287" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91288" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">10 </hi>Therefore restrained over you Are the heavens from dew; And the earth from producing is restrained:<div eID="gen91288" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91289" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">11 </hi>Yea, I have called for drought On the land and on the mountains, And on the corn and the wine and the oil, And on everything which the earth produces, On man and on beast, And on every labour of the hands. (<hi type="bold">338</hi>)<div eID="gen91289" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91290" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">12 </hi>And Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Josedech, the high priest, and all the residue of the people, attended to the voice of Jehovah, their God, and to the words of Haggai, the Prophet, as Jehovah their God had sent him; and the people feared Jehovah.<div eID="gen91290" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91291" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">13 </hi>Then said Haggai, the messenger of Jehovah, according to Jehovah’s message, saying to the people, “With you am I,” saith Jehovah.<div eID="gen91291" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91292" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">14 </hi>And Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the people; and the came and carried on the work in the Temple of Jehovah of hosts, their God,<div eID="gen91292" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91293" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">15 </hi>on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king. <note n="155"> <div sID="gen91294" type="x-p"/> What is said in a Note in <a href="/ccel/Calvin/comm_vol29.htm|vol29.p347.note">p. 347</a> does not apply to what <hi type="italic">Calvin</hi> says. He refers not, as I inadvertently apprehended, to the present division of the chapter, but to that adopted in the Septuagint; for this verse in that version forms the beginning of the next chapter. — <hi type="italic">Ed</hi>.<div eID="gen91294" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91295" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen91295" type="x-p"/> </note><div eID="gen91293" type="x-p"/><div eID="gen91277"/> <div sID="gen91296"/> <div sID="gen91297" type="x-p"/>CHAPTER 2.<div eID="gen91297" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91298" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">1 </hi>In the seventh month, and on the twenty-first day, came the word of Jehovah to Haggai, the Prophet, saying, —<div eID="gen91298" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91299" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">2 </hi>Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to all the residue of the people, saying, —<div eID="gen91299" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91300" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">3 </hi>Who among you is alive, Who saw this house in its former glory, And how do ye see it now? Is it not to that as nothing in your eyes?<div eID="gen91300" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91301" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">4 </hi>Yet now strong be thou Zerubbabel, saith Jehovah; And strong be all the people of the land; And work, for with you am I, Saith Jehovah of hosts,<div eID="gen91301" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91302" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">5 </hi>According to the word I covenanted with you, When ye came forth from Egypt, And my Spirit shall be in the midst of you, fear ye not. (<hi type="bold">354</hi>)<div eID="gen91302" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91303" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, — Yet for a little while shall be this,<div eID="gen91303" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91304" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">7 </hi>And I will shake the heavens and the earth, Also the sea and the dry land: Yea, I will shake all nations, And come shall the choice things of all nations; And I will fill this house with glory, Saith Jehovah of hosts:<div eID="gen91304" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91305" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">8 </hi>Mine the silver and mine the gold, Saith Jehovah of hosts:<div eID="gen91305" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91306" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">9 </hi>Greater shall be the glory Of this latter house than that of the former, Saith Jehovah of hosts; And in this place will I give peace, Saith Jehovah of hosts.<div eID="gen91306" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91307" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">10 </hi>On the twenty-fourth of the ninth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah to Haggai, the Prophet, saying, —<div eID="gen91307" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91308" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">11 </hi>Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Ask the priests respecting the law, saying, —<div eID="gen91308" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91309" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">12 </hi>If a man carry holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any eatable, shall it be made holy? And the priests answered and said, No.<div eID="gen91309" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91310" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">13 </hi>Then said Haggai, If any one polluted in his person touch any of these things, shall it be polluted? The priests answered and said, It shall be polluted.<div eID="gen91310" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91311" type="x-p"/>14 Then answered Haggai, and said, — So is this people, and so is this nation, In my sight, saith Jehovah; And so is every work of their hands, And what they offer, — it is polluted.<div eID="gen91311" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91312" type="x-p"/>15 And now I pray, lay it to heart, — From this day and beyond it, Before a stone was laid on a stone In the temple of Jehovah, —<div eID="gen91312" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91313" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">16 </hi>Before this time, when one came To a heap of twenty, there were but ten <hi type="italic">measures</hi>, When he came to the vat to draw fifty, There were from the vat but twenty <hi type="italic">vessels</hi>:<div eID="gen91313" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91314" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">17 </hi>I smote you with blasting and mildew and hail, As to every work of you hands; And ye turned not to me, saith Jehovah.<div eID="gen91314" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91315" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">18 </hi>Lay it, I pray, to your heart, — From this day and beyond it, From the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, From the day the temple of Jehovah was founded; — Lay it to your heart, —<div eID="gen91315" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91316" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">19 </hi>Is there now seed in the barn? And as yet the vine and the fig tree, And the pomegranate and the olive, Have produced nothing; — From this day will I bless you. (<hi type="bold">378</hi>)<div eID="gen91316" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91317" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">20 </hi>And the word of Jehovah came again to Haggai, on the twenty-fourth of the month, saying, —<div eID="gen91317" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91318" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">21 </hi>Speak to Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah, saying, —<div eID="gen91318" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91319" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">22 </hi>I will shake the heavens and the earth, And will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, And destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; Yea, I will overthrow chariots and their riders, And down shall come the horses and their riders, Every one by the sword of his brother:<div eID="gen91319" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen91320" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">23 </hi>In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, I will take the Zerubbabel, The son of Shealtiel, my servant, saith Jehovah, And I will make thee as a signet, For I have chosen thee, saith Jehovah of hosts.<div eID="gen91320" type="x-p"/><div eID="gen91296"/><div eID="gen91273"/><div eID="gen91126"/> <div sID="gen91321"/> <title level="1">Indexes</title> <div sID="gen91322"/> <title                <ns0:head>CHAP. II.</ns0:head>
               <ns0:p n="1">1 IN the seventh <ns0:note n="a" place="bottom">Which the <ns0:hi>Hebrews</ns0:hi> called <ns0:hi>Tisri,</ns0:hi> and <ns0:hi>Ethanim,</ns0:hi> and it an<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />swers to part of our <ns0:hi>September</ns0:hi> and to part of <ns0:hi>October.</ns0:hi>
                  </ns0:note> 
                  <ns0:hi>moneth,</ns0:hi> in the one and twentieth <ns0:note n="b" place="bottom">Some seven weeks after the first, mention'd in the first Chapter, and about one moneth after they began to build, or at least pre<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />par'd for building the Temple.</ns0:note> 
                  <ns0:hi>day</ns0:hi> of the moneth, came the word of the LORD <ns0:note n="†" place="margin">Heb. <ns0:hi>by th<ns0:gap reason="illegible" resp="#PDCC" extent="1 letter">
                           <ns0:desc>•</ns0:desc>
                        </ns0:gap> hand of.</ns0:hi>
                  </ns0:note> by the prophet Haggai <ns0:note n="c" place="bottom">Vid. <ns0:hi>chap.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>ver.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>let.</ns0:hi> c.d.e.</ns0:note>, saying,</ns0:p>
               <ns0:p n="2">2 Speak now <ns0:note n="d" place="bottom">Once again acquaint them with what I now impart for their encouragement.</ns0:note> to Zerubbabel <ns0:note n="e" place="bottom">Vid. <ns0:hi>chap.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>ver.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>let.</ns0:hi> f.</ns0:note> the son of Shealtiel <ns0:note n="f" place="bottom">Ibid. <ns0:hi>let.</ns0:hi> g.</ns0:note> governour <ns0:note n="g" place="bottom">Ibid. <ns0:hi>let.</ns0:hi> h.</ns0:note> of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech the high-priest <ns0:note n="h" place="bottom">Vid. <ns0:hi>chap.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>ver.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>let.</ns0:hi> k. l. m. See also <ns0:hi>chap.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>ver.</ns0:hi> 12. where these persons are mentioned.</ns0:note>, and to the residue <ns0:note n="i" place="bottom">See <ns0:hi>chap.</ns0:hi> 1. <ns0:hi>ver.</ns0:hi> 12. <ns0:hi>let.</ns0:hi> e. f.</ns0:note> of the people, saying,</ns0:p>
               <ns0:p n="3">3 Who <ns0:hi>is</ns0:hi> left among you <ns0:note n="k" place="bottom">There are surely some that are of that Age as to have seen the Temple which our Fathers sins, Gods just displeasure, and the <ns0:hi>Chaldean</ns0:hi> malice burnt, who are they? and where may they be found? this question implieth there were such, and by <ns0:hi>Ezra</ns0:hi> 3.12, 13. appears there were many, for the cries and sobs of them equall'd the shouts of the younger, who reioiced to see the foundations of the second house laid.</ns0:note> that saw <ns0:note n="l" place="bottom">Took notice of it then, and remember it now, that were of such age and know<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ledge as to remember what was standing in its glory (one hun<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />dred and fifty years ago if some conjecture aright, but what is nearer to truth) who remember some fourscore years past, who are about one hundred years of Age.</ns0:note> this house <ns0:note n="m" place="bottom">The house of God, the Temple built by <ns0:hi>Solomon.</ns0:hi>
                  </ns0:note> in her first <ns0:note n="n" place="bottom">In the stately structure of it, in the rich adornings of it, in the unparallel'd skill and cu<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />riosity of its Workmanship, when 'twas the Glory of the World.</ns0:note> glory? and how do ye see it now <ns0:note n="o" place="bottom">Do you see the same Glorious Structure going for<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ward? Have you expectation of one equal to the former Tem<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ple?</ns0:note>? <ns0:note n="*" place="margin">Zech. 4.10.</ns0:note> 
                  <ns0:hi>is it</ns0:hi> not in your eyes <ns0:note n="p" place="bottom">You cannot but recal the former to mind, and make your judgment of this by that.</ns0:note> in com<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />parison of it, as nothing <ns0:note n="q" place="bottom">Do you not judge this se<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />cond nothing comparable with the first, you are ready to say (in proverbial speech) it is nothing to it.</ns0:note>?</ns0:p>
               <ns0:p n="4">
                  <ns0:pb facs="tcp:64193:199" />4 Yet now <ns0:note n="r" place="bottom">In this juncture, though old men weep for the dispropor<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />tion of the two Temples, yet now.</ns0:note>
